command:
cd /exercise && python3 - <<'PY'
p = 'Cargo.toml'
s = open(p).read()
if 'default = ["advanced"]' not in s:
    s = s.replace('[features]', '[features]\n# exercise step 5: enable the covariance / Send / Sync tests by default\ndefault = ["advanced"]')
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("patched Cargo.toml")
PY
echo '--- Cargo.toml ---' && cat Cargo.toml && echo '--- grader command (default features) ---' && cargo test --offline -- --include-ignored 2>&1 | tail -n 40
